claim: Because every COMPOSE state is a complete molecule and every transition is executable, an exact labeled-subgraph requirement can be imposed on every committed state, not merely on the endpoint. Endpoint-only filtering can return a valid final molecule after traversing forbidden intermediates; support masking makes those states unreachable by construction.
non_claims: that constrained control beats unconstrained control on the objective
that the protected motif is a medicinally meaningful pharmacophore
that future-aware control beats greedy under the mask (its sign is guaranteed by policy improvement)

frozen_inputs.r_theta: runs/run_v2_01 selected checkpoint on volume compose-v4-artifacts at /artifacts/editing_v2/r_theta_run; NOT retrained, NOT modified
frozen_inputs.goal_language: B = P AND D, taken verbatim from modal_apps/retarget_intervention_app.py

constraint.definition: at every committed state x_t, the protected motif embeds into x_t as an exact atom/bond-labeled subgraph (monomorphism, not necessarily induced)
constraint.atom_label: atomic number AND aromaticity flag AND formal charge
constraint.outside_the_motif: unconstrained; substitution and deletion elsewhere is the room to act

motif_rule.definition: the largest fused ring system of the SOURCE (connected components of the ring-bond graph), taken with exact labels
motif_rule.tie_break: atom count, then ring count, then sorted atom-index tuple
motif_rule.reads: the source molecule only; no trajectory, no successor set, no arm outcome

eligibility.deliberately_not_a_criterion: 'the frozen kernel offers both motif-preserving and motif-destroying legal successors' -- it is the numerator of the vacuity gate, so filtering on it would make a non-vacuous mask true by construction
eligibility.selection_rule: first N eligible sources in scan order under seed 20260813; no ranking, no preference

protocol.independent_statistical_unit: the source molecule; rollouts from one source are repeated measures

stage_A.unconstrained_greedy: greedy on u_B over the full legal support; context and the source of the vacuity gate
stage_A.endpoint_only: 6 stochastic unconstrained goal-directed rollouts; keep those with a motif-valid ENDPOINT; return the best by u_B
stage_A.pathwise_greedy: greedy on u_B over the masked support
stage_A.pathwise_stochastic: budget-matched twin of endpoint_only: same rollout count, same policy, masked support
stage_A.mask_only_sampling: sample R_theta over the masked support with NO goal; separates feasibility from objective control

stage_B.unconstrained_verified: verified remaining-budget control over the full support; like-for-like partner for the cost of the guarantee
stage_B.pathwise_verified: verified remaining-budget control inside the masked support

primary_metrics: endpoint_valid_path_invalid rate on unconstrained_greedy and on endpoint_only rollouts
paired terminal utility, pathwise_stochastic minus endpoint_only
secondary_metrics: marginal kernel calls per arm in run order

not_measurements.zero_violations_on_masked_arms: definitional; reported as a bug detector only, never with a denominator or a p-value
not_measurements.pathwise_verified_minus_pathwise_greedy: sign guaranteed by policy improvement on both utility and binary success; only magnitude, top-1 disagreement, and headroom over the greedy-failure denominator are admissible

gates.G0_mask_integrity: any committed violation on a masked arm voids the run
gates.G1_constraint_non_vacuous: STOP if endpoint_valid_path_invalid < 0.10 on both the trajectory and the rollout denominators
gates.G3_feasible_paths_can_improve: STOP if no pathwise arm improves u_B over the source on any panel member
gates.G4_distinguishable: STOP if endpoint_only and pathwise_stochastic land identically on every source

allowed_calibration: eligibility constants may be set from the SOURCE-ONLY census yield, since no successor enumeration, trajectory or arm outcome enters it
horizon may be checked once on held-in smoke if H=6 proves too short to expose any violation
forbidden_adaptations: changing the motif rule until one makes a desired arm win
retraining or modifying R_theta, the kernel, or the operators
adding kernel-derived criteria to source eligibility
reporting the definitional zero as a finding
